claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows PS5 logo band on every spine, not PS4 packaging.
No separate photo shows sealed or brand-new stock; only the used lot is visible.
Delivery capability cannot be assessed from a photo.

risks.proof: Close-up photo or video of each disc's playing surface
risks.if_unproven: priced as heavily scratched / playability not guaranteed

risks.risk: Missing manuals, inlay art, or inner case inserts
risks.proof: Photo of each case opened showing full contents

risks.risk: Region lock or disc authenticity (counterfeit/reburned discs)
risks.proof: Clear photo of disc hub print quality and region code text
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified authenticity, worst case counterfeit risk

risks.risk: Seller's platform mismatch (claims PS4, witness sees PS5 branding)
risks.proof: Seller to confirm console platform with a clear spine/back-cover photo
risks.if_unproven: priced strictly as PS5 titles per witness, ignoring seller's PS4 claim

risks.risk: Exact title count and duplicates (e.g., two FC25 copies) not confirmed as sellable complete set
risks.proof: Full inventory list with photo of each case front and back
risks.if_unproven: priced per lowest-value base title until itemized

proof_requests: Close-up video of each disc's playing surface
Photo of each case opened to show manual/inlay presence
Clear shot of disc hub showing region code and print quality
A single unambiguous photo confirming PS4 vs PS5 console platform
Full title-by-title photo list with case backs visible
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies a lot of used PS5 game cases, so a worst-case price can be set despite the seller's unverified PS4 claim and missing disc/content proof.
